text_block_list.text:
While keeping Winning Ticket company as 
she studied for her makeup exam after 
failing a test...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... I don't get this at aaall...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sub-sti-toot numbers? What does that 
mean~...? Find the... sum? What's a 
suuuum~???

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah...! No waaaay, I hate thiiis...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“—No no, absolutely not! If I get 
discouraged here, I won't be able to race 
or train anymore!”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! I just gotta give it everything 
I've goooooot!!

(Scratch, scratch, scratch, scratch...! 
Scribble, scribble, scribble, 
scribble...!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aba, ababa, abababababaaa...! My head... 
my head is... pounding—

Because she pushed herself too hard on her 
dreaded studying, Winning Ticket ended up 
plagued by a headache...
